channel.title: GNUS digest
channel.description: Daily digest of the GeniusVentures GitHub activity, written from public commit messages.

item.title: GNUS digest — Sunday 15 November
item.description: The wallet added temporary diagnostic prints and enhanced verification diagnostics. Repositories: GeniusWallet, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Saturday 14 November
item.description: The network roadmap and backup documentation were expanded, and the backup system was rewritten to support tiered archive and light node models. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Friday 13 November
item.description: The AI system removed an outdated submodule and updated its documentation. The network backup and cold‑storage processes were upgraded, and storage cleanup retained markers across eviction. Repositories: GeniusCognitiveSystem, GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, GNUS-NEO-SWARM, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Thursday 12 November
item.description: New lockout scenarios, a warrant resale lockout control, and an investor cash chart were added to the dashboard, along with formatting fixes and test coverage. The SDK added a payout address function, improved self‑hosted runner handling, introduced rotating refresh tokens, and added a numeric keypad component. Repositories: gnus-investor-scenarios, GeniusSDK, thirdparty, openapi-client-scaffold, GeniusWallet, SuperGenius, libp2p, openapi-cpp-scaffolding.

item.title: GNUS digest — Wednesday 11 November
item.description: An audit confirmed the network milestone requirements were met, and payout address getters were added to accounts and nodes. The wallet added real earnings counts, and the SDK added support for idempotency keys in requests. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, GeniusWallet, SuperGenius, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, GeniusSDK, CIDocker.

item.title: GNUS digest — Tuesday 10 November
item.description: The network roadmap and milestone documents were created, and the backup system was updated. The SDK introduced service registration, rotating refresh tokens, and password hashing, while the dashboard got design language and contrast improvements. Repositories: openapi-cpp-scaffolding, SuperGenius, GeniusNetwork, gnus-dashboard.
